L2_data_source_availability.notes: Data layer is in the strongest state of any cohort 1 chapter: a dedicated Moos folder with reconciled NSW CSV + 10 BEA NIPA tables + 9 FRED series. Construction inputs S607 and BEA_GDP/BEA_NIPA are all cached.

evidence.ES1201_methodology_summary: Populated: 'NSW/GDP ratio from Shaikh & Tonak (2002), covering the full postwar period 1952-1997. Derived as (E1-T1+(E2-T2)*LS)/GDP using NIPA data. Average value essentially zero over the 45-year period; fluctuates within +/-3% of GDP driven primarily by unemployment.'
evidence.ES1202_methodology_summary: Populated: 'NSW/EC ratio from Shaikh & Tonak (2002), covering 1952-1997. Primary measure in the paper (Figure 29.3). Average 0.6% over 45 years — effectively zero.'
evidence.formula_present: Both: NSW = (E1-T1)+(E2-T2)*LS; ES1201 divides by GDP, ES1202 divides by EC
evidence.decision_record_reference: Both reference internal decision (2026-05-06) that ST2 P21 implements NSW = E1 - (T1 + T2*LS) — E2 excluded; overlap mean NSW/GDP = 0.013 vs Moos published 0.011 (V11 benchmark range [0.008, 0.018])
evidence.phase_structure_documented: Both research JSONs document 4-phase structure (Boom 1952-1969 negative; Crisis 1969-1975 peak +9%; Reagan-Bush 1975-1989 decline; Clinton 1989-1997 near zero)

L3_methodology_clarity.notes: Methodology is the strongest part of this chapter — both formulas, classification rules, decision records, worked example, and phase structure are fully documented.

evidence.required_fields_present: Both have name, study, chapter, year_range, subseries, construction, validation, processor, wave, status, units, content_type, year_range_target
evidence.construction_with_formula: Both have op='derive' with formula ('NSW / GDP' for ES1201, 'NSW / EC' for ES1202) and inputs [S607, BEA_GDP/BEA_NIPA]
evidence.status_downgrade_documented: Both have status_downgrade_note from Hyper-review 2026-05-19 explaining 'book_period_validated' status given extension:null
evidence.year_range_inflation: Both have year_range [1952, 2025] while subseries period and year_range_target are [1952, 1997] — registry top-level inflated for visualization margin but inconsistent with extension:null
evidence.construction_thinness: Single-step construction (op='derive') does not enumerate the E1/E2/T1/T2/LS component decomposition — relies entirely on S607's internal construction
